note: Allowance units per feature (docs/usage-metering-20261115.md). The relay charges the newest version whose effectiveFrom has passed, while metering is switched on (inference.metering). Every usage record keeps the version it was charged under. Change a weight only by adding a new version: run scripts/usage-metering.ts suggest, then the owner approves the proposal and the agent appends it here. Never edit an existing version.

prices.source: Privatemode pricing page as copied in docs/privatemode-master-notes.md section 6 (owner's notes, read 11 November 2026). EUR, before VAT. Used for euro estimates by the scripts and for the cost figure of a background run in the ledger; never charged to users. Owner-reported on 16 November 2026: the portal shows a price list with input, cached input and output per 1M tokens per model and audio per minute; the figures here are still those of 11 November until the owner confirms they match. A changed price is a new version here, never an edit.

Version 1 unchanged, plus image creation (docs/image-creation-20261118.md, 18 November 2026): per-image list prices from public pages, converted from USD at 1.08 and rounded up, to confirm in the provider contract before any live use: FLUX.2 [klein] USD 0.015, FLUX.2 [pro] USD 0.03, Imagen 4 Fast USD 0.02. The mock is free.
